sprint: World-Owned Text Quick-Edit Popup — Position:Fixed, Sidebar Overlap Allowed, Auto-Growing Words Field
task: A SECOND, real-content follow-up on the same popup: 'this is not what is intended' -- a screenshot showed the widened (300px) popup STILL scrolling internally against genuine production content (a real 3-line Cover-page byline), not the short synthetic single-line text the prior fix's own test suite had used. The user then explicitly relaxed the standing constraint: 'context menu can overlap on right and left panel that should be ok if needed.' Root cause of why widening alone couldn't be pushed further: .selection-action-strip was position:absolute inside .preview-area, and .preview-area{overflow:hidden} silently CLIPPED any popup content that tried to extend past .preview-area's own edge into the sidebar, no matter how much genuine unused screen space the sidebar had. Fix: switched to position:fixed (escapes .preview-area's clipping entirely) and rewrote js/selectionActionStrip.js's _positionWidget() around a real invariant instead of 'must fit entirely inside the gutter': the widget's NEAR edge always sits strictly on the far side of the canvas's own edge (structurally can never cross into it -- the one constraint that stays hard), and its own WIDTH is capped (not its position clamped) to whatever real room exists between that near edge and the true viewport edge -- capping width rather than clamping position guarantees the far edge can never compute past the real screen. The gate for choosing a side dropped from 'the full ~300-440px must fit' to 'at least 160px of real room exists', so a side placement is chosen far more often now, with the 'top' fallback reserved only for genuinely narrow viewports. The Words textarea auto-grows to fit real multi-line content via a delegated input listener plus a post-position autosize pass, and .selection-action-edit-panel .context-textarea dropped its earlier min-height:52px shrink override in favour of overflow-y:hidden so there's never a competing inner scrollbar. Verified via popup_realcontent_check.js (28 assertions, the exact real 3-line byline at 3 viewport sizes -- zero page scroll, no inner textarea scroll, all 9 controls visible, never overlaps the canvas, and confirmed to genuinely extend past .preview-area's own edge into the sidebar at a normal size) and popup_narrow_top_fallback_check.js (5 assertions, narrow-viewport fallback still never overlaps the canvas). Full regression across popup_layout_check.js (24/24), text_object_full_build_check.js (26/26), selection_strip_pencil_fix.js (18/18), repaint_fix_verify.js (8/8), canvas_click_visual_repro.js (6/6), paperbg_hittest_repro.js (3/3), commitments_test.js, sync_charm_test.js, and text_resize_grid_test.js (13/13) all pass unchanged. selection_action_strip_test.js's own 'sits entirely above' assertion was confirmed via git stash to have only ever passed because the OLD code happened to fall back to 'top' mode at that test's default viewport -- corrected to a real geometric overlap test, now passing 15/15. Both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged -- zero Builder-tooling impact. Confined to js/selectionActionStrip.js, css/style.css, and one corrected test assertion.
